props.heading: What happens on launch day
props.intro: Friday is the day the boats meet the water.

steps.title: Finishing touches
steps.text: A last coat of varnish and a check from the yard manager.

steps.title: Down the slipway
steps.text: Each group carries its boat to the water at high tide.

steps.title: First sail
steps.text: Students sail their own boats round the harbour, with families on the quay.
